description: This file contains the definition of the class PdfParser, which provides methods for parsing PDF files and extracting text from them. The class focuses on reading PDF content, handling compressed data, and extracting meaningful text information, though it is marked as deprecated.

classes.name: PdfParser
classes.description: A class for parsing PDF files to extract text content, providing static methods for parsing files and raw content, and internal methods for handling PDF data decoding and text extraction.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Reads a PDF file and extracts its text content.

methods.name: parseContent
methods.description: Extracts text from raw PDF content.

methods.name: extractText
methods.description: Converts PDF binary data into text by handling PDF objects and streams, decoding compressed data, and extracting text elements.

methods.name: extractTextElements
methods.description: Parses PDF content lines to extract readable text, handling operators and font encodings.

methods.name: parseTextCommand
methods.description: Processes text chunks to handle special characters and text formatting commands.

methods.name: getDataArray
methods.description: Extracts segments of data from PDF content based on start and end delimiters.
